python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
module = importlib.import_module('sqlparse.engine.grouping')
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'sqlparse/engine/grouping.py').resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
import sqlparse
from sqlparse import sql
for source in ("(a desc)","((b asc))"):
 statement=sqlparse.parse(source)[0]
 def visit(token):
  if isinstance(token,sql.Identifier) and token.get_ordering(): return [token]
  return [found for child in getattr(token,"tokens",[]) for found in visit(child)]
 ordered=visit(statement)
 print("nested_ordering",source,[(str(t),t.get_ordering()) for t in ordered])
 assert len(ordered)==1
 assert ordered[0].get_ordering() in ("ASC","DESC")
 assert str(statement)==source
